name: Facet
text:
Ship EXCAVA with system preference as the default dark mode, with a persistent toggle in settings.

Dark mode reduces eye strain and improves focus during long sessions, matching the competitive analysis where dark themes dominate high-performance dashboards. Forcing a one-time picker at first launch adds friction without proven benefit—most users stick with system defaults anyway. The trade-off is ignoring first-time users who prefer light mode, but their needs are secondary to the core audience’s workflow efficiency.

name: Pane
text: Defaulting to system preference alienates users who manually override their OS theme daily—like designers or night-shift workers—because it ignores their explicit preference. Instead, ship with a *reversible* default (last user choice) and a clear toggle labeled "Match system" that syncs only if toggled on, settled by A/B testing retention vs. preference satisfaction.
